title: IAM Strategy 300 recognizes Burford Capital's IP team members
summary: Burford Capital is pleased to share that IAM Strategy 300 has recognized six Burford team members as world-leading IP strategists. These individuals have been "identified by market sources for their exceptional skill sets and profound insights into patent matters." Learn more.
body_markdown:
Burford Capital is pleased to share that IAM Strategy 300 has recognized six Burford team members as world-leading IP strategists. These individuals have been " identified by market sources for their exceptional skill sets and profound insights into patent matters."


We congratulate[Katharine Wolanyk,](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/katharine-wolanyk/)[Eric Carlson](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/eric-carlson/) ,[Christopher Freeman,](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/christopher-freeman/)[Joshua Harris](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/joshua-harris/) ,[Josh Ree](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/josh-reed/) d and[Avik Chattaraj](https://www.burfordcapital.com/about-us/our-team/avik-chattaraj/) .


[Access the full list here.](https://www.iam-media.com/rankings/strategy-300/individuals)
